environment.openmp_runtime: pycolmap bundled libomp replaced by a symlink to the torch copy, inside the isolated environment

method.query_data: Non-keyframes from the same recording used to build each map; any frameset containing a mapping keyframe is excluded
method.retrieval: Cold global image retrieval; no MPS pose prior
method.success: At least 20 distinct inlier landmarks and both observation and landmark inlier ratios >= 0.2
method.query_duration: Measured after image staging; includes feature extraction, retrieval, matching, pose estimation and repeated model initialization
method.build_wall_duration: CLI startup through clean process exit, measured with /usr/bin/time
method.pose_disagreement: Successful queries with a timestamp-covered reference pose in the same MPS graph; same-recording self-consistency, not independent physical ground truth

limitations: This is retained setup provenance only, not the default evaluation, independent test sequences, or Pilot replay measurements
One sample and one run per mode; not an independent-recording benchmark or generalization result
MPS camera poses also constrain map construction; small pose disagreement does not establish millimetre localization accuracy
Weights were already cached; first-time network downloads are excluded
The example reloads models for each query; timings are not for a warm resident localization service
RGB produced 49 eligible strided queries rather than repeating frames to fill the request
Queries without timestamp-covered MPS references contribute to success counts but not pose-disagreement statistics

cached_slam_vio_replay.mode: recorded VIO replay with cached HLOC solves and measured delays
cached_slam_vio_replay.freshness_evaluated_on: recorded device timestamps, not live wall-clock
cached_slam_vio_replay.cache_provenance: Original measured query outputs; map_graph_uid added from the recorded source map manifest and query VRS fingerprint from the verified downloaded file. No new solves claimed.

actual_asynchronous_worker_replay.mode: recorded public VRS paced at device time through actual asynchronous LiveLocalizer; no glasses/SDK network, no cached solves

default_dataset: Pilot play_0 mapping / play_1 testing; see pilot_play_heldout.json and pilot_validation.json
